title: EARTH WIRE
summary: PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of PVC/XLPE Insulated Power and Control Cables, Service Cable, Aerial Bunched Cables upto 1.1 kV, MVCC upto
html:
PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of PVC/XLPE Insulated Power and Control Cables, Service Cable, Aerial Bunched Cables upto 1.1 kV, MVCC upto 11 KV and all type of Overhead Conductors i.e. AAC, ACSR, AACSR, AAAC, AL-59, ACAR, ECO and HTLS upto 800 KV lines as per BIS, BS, IEC, ASTM etc. to cater to requirements of majority of Electricity Boards in India and Overseas Supply.

GI EARTH WIRE

Earth wires are made from stranded galvanized high carbon steel wires. They comprise of 3 to 19 strands of such wires. All steel strands are smooth, uniform and free from imperfections such as die-marks, cents after drawing and standing, scratches and abrasion.

title: CONDUCTORS
summary: PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of all type of Overhead Conductors i.e. AAC, ACSR, AACSR, AAAC, AL-59, ACAR, ECO and HTLS upto 800 KV lines
html:
PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of all type of Overhead Conductors i.e. AAC, ACSR, AACSR, AAAC, AL-59, ACAR, ECO and HTLS upto 800 KV lines as per BIS, BS, IEC, ASTM etc. to cater to requirements of majority of Electricity Boards in India and Overseas Supply.

ALL ALUMINIUM CONDUCTOR (AAC)

Conductor Shall be all stranded circular (as per IEC 61089) or any other international specification such as BS, ASTM, DIN, Canadian, GOST & Swedish specification etc.

ALL ALUMINIUM ALOY CONDUCTOR (AAAC)

Conductor shall be Aluminium Magnesium Silicon alloy stranded circular (as per IEC 61089) or any other international specification, such as BS, ASTM, DIN, Canadian, GOST & Swedish specification etc.

ALUMINIUM CONDUCTOR STEEL REINFORCED (ACSR)

Conductor Shall be all stranded circular with steel reinforced (as per IEC 61889) or any other international specification such as BS, ASTM, DIN, Canadian, GOST & Swedish specification etc.

Read More
Read More
Read More

ALUMINIUM ALLOY CONDUCTOR STEEL REINFORCED (AACSR)

Conductor Shall be Aluminium, Magnesium, Silicon alloy stranded circular with steel reinforced (as per IEC 61889) or any other international specification such as BS, ASTM, DIN, Canadian, GOST & Swedish specification etc.

ALUMINIUM CONDUCTOR (AL-59)

Aluminium Magnesium Silicon alloy with minimum 59% conductivity, as compared to ACSR conductor of equivalent diameter or weight is having higher current carrying capacity.

ALUMINIUM CONDUCTOR ALLOY REINFORCED (ACAR)

ACAR has got a better mechanical and electrical properties as compared to an equivalent ACSR, AAC or AAAC. A very good balance between the mechanical and electrical properties therefore makes ACAR the best choice where the ampacity, strength and light weight are the main consideration of the line design.

Read More
Read More
Read More

ECO PANTHER CONDUCTOR

Eco Series conductors consists of trapezoidal shaped special Aluminium Alloy (AL-59) containing Magnesium, Silicon and Copper stranded with round core. The trapezoidal shape provides up to 96% compactness.

Read More

title: CABLES
summary: PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of PVC/XLPE Insulated Power and Control Cables, Service Cable, Aerial Bunched Cables upto 1.1 kV, MVCC upto
html:
PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of PVC/XLPE Insulated Power and Control Cables, Service Cable, Aerial Bunched Cables upto 1.1 kV, MVCC upto 11 KV as per BIS, BS, IEC, ASTM etc. to cater to requirements of majority of Electricity Boards in India and Overseas Supply.

AERIAL BUNCHED CABLE (AB CABLE)

XLPE/HDPE insulated power conductors of Aluminium (Neutra conductor, street lighting conductors if and when necessary) are laid together (twisted) around a high tensile stranded and galvanized streel (Aluminium Alloy may be used) insulated or bare messenger wire to form the Aerial Bunched Cable.

LT XLPE CABLE

XLPE is an acronym for cross linked polyethylene. XLPE is a thermosetting polymer meaning that the material (polyethylene (PE)) is cured under heat and in the process forms bonds in all directions forming a three-dimensional matrix.

PVC POWER CABLE

A PVC Cable – meaning poly vinyl chloride – is an electrical cable that is coated with PVC and offers superior insulation and protection to the main wire. PVC insulated cables provide property owners with several advantages. They have no chemical properties and hence, can widely be used in various chemical industries.

Read More
Read More
Read More

CONTROL CABLE

Control Cables are multi-conductor cables used in automation and instrumentation applications. Control cables can measure and regulate transmissions of automated processes. Control cables are often UL rated. Control cables typically are shielded with a foil shield, braid shield or combination of the two.

SERVICE CABLE

Service Cable means that portion of the company’s cables, wires ducts and conduits C connected to the main distribution cable and located on the premises to the applicant or customer for whom service is or will be supplied.

COVERED CONDUCTORS FOR OVERHEAD LINES

Covered conductors consist of a conductor surrounded by a covering made of insulating material as protection against accidental contacts with other covered conductors and with grounded parts such as tree branches, etc. In comparison with insulated conductors, this covering has reduced properties but is able to withstand the phase-to-earth voltage temporarily. covered conductors for overhead lines having a nominal voltage U above 1 kV AC up to and including 36 kV AC.

title: About Us
summary: Background PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of PVC/XLPE Insulated Power and Control Cables, Service Cable, Aerial Bunched Cables upto 11 KV
html:
Background

PCI Cables is one of the leading manufacturers of PVC/XLPE Insulated Power and Control Cables, Service Cable, Aerial Bunched Cables upto 11 KV and all type of Overhead Conductors i.e. AAC, ACSR, AACSR, AAAC, AL-59, ACAR upto 800 KV lines as per BIS, BS, IEC, ASTM etc. to cater to requirements of majority of Electricity Boards in India and Overseas supply.

The Company is one of the pioneers in the business by virtue of its cost-effectiveness, reliability and Product Quality.

The Company has state of the art manufacturing unit at West Bengal with modern Infrastructure with latest Machinery, Equipment and test laboratory required for production of quality products. With Continuous and Systematic efforts to achieve high standards of quality have been recognised with award of ISO 9001-2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified organization.

Specialization

Wires and cables permeate through every aspect of our modern lifestyle, which commands uninterrupted and efficient electricity supply. From planes to trains, telecommunication to entertainment, satellites to Wifi – wires are the omnipresent, unsung heroes pulsating with electricity, bringing surroundings to life and bridging distances. 

The Company’s diverse product offerings are nimble and energy efficient, minimizing losses, tending security and earning you savings through every millimeter it pervades. The Company has been lauded with several product and system certifications and awards that speak for quality and dependable wires, making it one of the best quality wire and cable company in India. 

Diversification

Now a days, we are spreading our wings in the field of EPC and Turkey contracting in the sector of power transmission and distribution system. We have bagged a new project of 45 Crore from Assam Power Distribution Company Limited to construct new Substation.

We are also started manufacturing of Transmission & Distribution line hardware accessories, Tubular Poles, Galvanised Structure and Tower along with all types of Cable Drums in our sister concern company ADEEP INDUSTRIES.

We are dreaming to provide all types of supports and solutions for Transmission & Distribution line beneath one umbrella.

title: PCI Cables have participated at Elecrama 2025
summary: We, PCI Cables Industries Pvt. Ltd., proudly participated in ELECRAMA 2025, the world’s largest electrical and allied-equipment exhibition held at India
html:
We, PCI Cables Industries Pvt. Ltd., proudly participated in ELECRAMA 2025, the world’s largest electrical and allied-equipment exhibition held at India Expo Mart, Greater Noida. Our presence at this prestigious global platform underscored our commitment to innovation, quality, and technological advancement in the cable manufacturing industry.

At our stall, we showcased our comprehensive range of high-performance cables designed for industrial, infrastructure, and power transmission applications. ELECRAMA 2025 provided us an excellent opportunity to interact with engineers, industry leaders, EPC companies, utility representatives, and international buyers. The event enabled us to highlight our manufacturing capabilities, technical expertise, and dedication to delivering reliable solutions for emerging energy and electrical demands.

Our participation strengthened our brand visibility, opened avenues for strategic collaborations, and allowed us to gain valuable insights into the future of the power and electrical ecosystem. We extend our gratitude to all visitors, partners, and industry professionals who engaged with us during the event and contributed to making our ELECRAMA 2025 experience a successful one.

The benefits we aimed for include:

  • Showcasing their cable products and manufacturing capabilities to a wide industry audience.
  • Engaging with potential buyers — utilities, infrastructure firms, EPC contractors, or other industrial clients.
  • Exploring supply-chain partnerships or distribution channels, possibly including export-oriented opportunities.
  • Keeping abreast of industry trends, standards, and networking with other players in power transmission, renewable energy, and related sectors.

title: First Order Received of ECO Panther Conductor
summary: PCI Cables bags the first order for ECO Panther conductor for Renewable Energy Project at MP on this March WHAT IS ECO CONDUCTOR ? The Series Eco
html:
PCI Cables bags the first order for ECO Panther conductor for Renewable Energy Project at MP on this March

WHAT IS ECO CONDUCTOR ?

The Series Eco conductors consists special Aluminium alloy containing magnesium, silicon with trapezoidal shaped and Aluminium Alloy stranded with round core. The trapezoidal shape maintains upto 96% compactness.

Eco series conductors are most economical solution for re-conductoring any power line and constructing new lines. Our normal grid system consists with ACSR or AAAC conductor. This Eco conductor series is the best substitute and higher efficient than our existing system. It also reduces the emissions of power during the supply to the customers.

Now a days, Eco conductors are uses at renewable energy projects due to its higher efficiency and low emission of electricity.
